expect_nodes.note: the callee. Qname-qualified because the mechanism LITERAL is the callee's resolved qname (`Module::Class::method`), not a textual name.

expect_edges.note: RESOLVED (LA.34): the unqualified self-call `add(acc, x)` inside `total` is classified in the parser by Dart's lexical scope (locals, then the class's own members, then library scope): `add` is a member of Calc, so it is emitted as a SelfMethod and graph resolve_calls binds it against the enclosing CLASS's methods. History: MEASURED ABSENT 2026-09-16 (zero CALLS: collect_calls_in matched only a `selector_expression`, which tree-sitter-dart 0.1.0 does not have; `this.add(acc, x)` emitted nothing either); after LA.23e the call was emitted as `Bare(add)` and stayed unresolved, since the Bare arm never looks in the enclosing class. Recall 0/1 -> 1/1.

note: A15.12 structural gap-fill. Baseline 2026-09-16, installed 0.4.18 wheel: 6 nodes / 5 edges, zero CALLS. Also measured absent: the cross-object call `Calc().total([1, 2, 3])` in main.dart produced no CALLS edge because `main()` is a top-level function whose sibling function_body (tree-sitter-dart 0.1.0 puts it beside the signature) was never walked. Since LA.37a the body is walked: `Calc()` is a Bare call and `.total(..)` on the constructor result a ComplexReceiver, and neither binds - `Calc` lives in calc.dart, reached only through the whole-library `import 'calc.dart'` (an ImportTarget::Module, which binds no symbol names), and the Bare arm looks in import bindings and the calling module's own symbols, so this cross-file constructor call stays unresolved (a same-file constructor call in a top-level body binds the CLASS). dart is one of only two languages still `unknown` on the calls column.
